Which shortwave stations broadcast aimed at Pacific?

In the A-26 schedule, 32 stations broadcast aimed at Pacific. The most heavily scheduled include CRI DIGITAL, RNZ Pacific, China Radio International, RNZ Pacific DIGITAL.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts aimed at Pacific?

The most-used frequencies are 9700, 9780, 13730, 11725, 17675 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
